description.en: CIVIC is an Edinburgh-based digital agency offering accessibility evaluations and testing services to help clients' online communications meet current accessibility regulations.

sourceRefs.label: Homepage lists "Accessibility evaluations and testing" as a service: "We use our deep understanding of the latest regulations to ensure online communications are accessible for all."; HQ at 12 South Charlotte Street, Edinburgh; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: Direct Access Group is a UK accessibility consultancy, headquartered in Nantwich, Cheshire, offering website accessibility audits and WCAG compliance support alongside its built-environment access-audit work.

sourceRefs.label: Site describes itself as "an award-winning, full-service accessibility consultancy specialising in access audits, regulatory compliance, and inclusive design strategy across built and digital environments," listing "Website Accessibility Audits" and WCAG compliance support; HQ address "Pepper House, Market Street, Nantwich, Cheshire, CW5 5DQ"; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: Labscape is a London-based accessibility firm providing technical testing, design consultancy and training, drawing on over five years of WCAG, Section 508 and DDA experience from its Central London test centre.

sourceRefs.label: Site states "With more than 5 years experience of the WCAG, Section 508 and the DDA, few companies can match our credentials" and offers "Accessibility Testing, Training and Consultancy" from "a fully-equipped Test Centre in Central London"; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: Agile Collective is an Oxford-based worker co-operative offering accessibility audits, training and consultancy, using manual, real-user and automated testing to assess sites against WCAG 2.1 AA.

sourceRefs.label: Page titled "Accessibility Audits, Training and Consultancy" states they run "a systematic, reliable, and in-depth assessment...against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1) 'AA' level"; address "21b Park End Street, Oxford OX1 1HU"; footer copyright "©2011-2026 Agile Collective Limited"; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: Net Progress is a UK digital accessibility and inclusion consultancy providing manual WCAG accessibility audits, assistive-technology testing and user testing for websites, apps and native applications.

sourceRefs.label: Site states "Manual auditing is the only way to accurately and fully assess WCAG technical compliance," covering wireframes, designs, prototypes, coded pages and native applications; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: Parachute Design is a Toronto-based web design and accessibility firm offering WCAG 2.2 AA compliance audits, remediation, accessible new builds, ongoing monitoring and AODA accessibility-statement support.

sourceRefs.label: Site states "We audit your existing website against WCAG 2.2 AA criteria. You get a full report: every issue, the WCAG criterion it fails, severity level, and the fix required"; address "29 Dominion Road, Toronto, Ontario M8W 1J5, Canada"; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: GIOV is a Montreal digital accessibility consultancy run by Eric Giovannetti, offering accessibility audits, advisory consulting and training aligned with WCAG and Quebec's SGQRI 008 standard.

sourceRefs.label: Page titled "Audit d'accessibilite numerique" lists three service lines "Audit," "Conseil" and "Formation," with bio "Eric Giovannetti, Consultant en accessibilite numerique"; footer "(c) GIOV 2010 - 2026"; live fetch 2026-08-13

description.en: Canaxess is a Canberra-based digital accessibility consultancy led by director Ross Mullen, offering accessibility assessments against accessibility guidelines plus coaching and training programs.

sourceRefs.label: Homepage states "We specialise in accessibility at every stage of your journey, helping you build better digital products with our accessibility expertise," listing website/app accessibility assessments and Accessibility Coaching and Training; live fetch 2026-08-13
